# First, search for the file 'team-building-activities.docx'
files = search_files_by_filename('team-building-activities.docx')

    raise ValueError("File 'team-building-activities.docx' not found.")

# Get the file details
file = files[0]
file_id = file.id_
content = file.content

# Use AI assistant to suggest two more team-building activities based on the existing content
class SuggestedActivities(BaseModel):
    activities: list[str]

    f"Based on the following team-building activities, suggest two more unique and engaging activities that would complement the existing list. Do not repeat any of the existing activities.\n\nExisting activities:\n{content}",
    SuggestedActivities
)

# Prepare the content to append
new_activities_text = "\n".join([f"- {activity}" for activity in suggested.activities])
append_content = f"\n\nSuggested new activities:\n{new_activities_text}"

# Append the new activities to the file
append_to_file(file_id, append_content)

  - Date: Every Thursday
  - Time: 12:00 - 13:00

  - Description: A workshop led by a local artist where team members engage in creative activities such as painting, sculpting, or drawing.
